component.name: Acer Control Center — Linux Edition
component.summary: Precision Hardware Atelier for Acer Aspire 7 A715-59G on Linux

description.p: Acer Control Center — Linux Edition is a native C++23 and Qt 6 Quick desktop hardware management and telemetry application engineered for the Acer Aspire 7 A715-59G on Fedora Linux 45.

It provides real-time CPU, memory, thermal, battery, and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 telemetry, verified Intel P-State and TuneD/PPD performance profile management, interactive fan curve visualization, an unrestricted sRGB/HSV/HSL Keyboard Lighting Studio independent of the application theme accent color, and privacy-redacted hardware diagnostics.
